Nice to meet you.
I am a Vtuber working independently. My name is Sensai Tsuina. Tsuina is an angelic idol from heaven.
I am contacting you to request the creation of my Twitch logo in preparation for my debut!

The main feelings I would like the logo to show:
She brings joy to heaven through her music. Please make a peaceful and heavenly idol logo!

She has sea coloured hair, a golden musical angelic halo, and wings with golden diamonds in them. She also has pink ribbons and a really pretty white dress. Her necklace and earrings are all musically themed.

TEXT: 
Sensai Tsuina (big)
仙斎ついな (small)

Please choose the layout of text as you'd like! 

Please feel free to include details from my design like my Halo, Wings and Necklace in the design as you see fit!

I would prefer if it has a more 'classical' look, like a heavenly angel, than a cartoony look. (not bubbly)

[Usage]
・Twitch
・Use in broadcast screens and social media
・Merchandise
・Animation

[Remarks]
・We would like to receive the data in PSD format with the background separated.

I look forward to working with you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ySSeTAwsvpFZ9MwY7Y2r4Wrb33XAswEA?usp=drive_link

・FC自体の設定や雰囲気としては「元教会の審問官だった人らが傭兵になって名残を残して活動してる」といった感じです
・その他はお任せいたします。

主な使用用途は、SNSやFC募集、SS撮影時のロゴに使わせていただきたいです。メンバーにも共有したいと思っています。
ですから透過されてるものと背景があるものも頂けると嬉しいです。基本的にチーム関係のみで使っていきます。
